name: Memories of an End
source:
It is naive to think everyone could come out of this unscathed and even more naive to believe anything you did would change it.

What it did was only prolong their suffering and even those you saved have little left of themselves to continue. What is the point of living if you are hollow?

But I digress. I know you will continue to fight this pointless battle seeking an impossible anyways. 

Memories of an End is a visual novel set in a fictional world. It is a story-heavy choice-based game where every character interaction is meant to be unique.

[From [url=https://twicepeace.itch.io/memories-of-an-end]itch.io[/url]]
